title: BSC scan: doctolib-lab/doctobert
summary: Clinical-adjacent French medical LLM pretraining pipeline (arXiv:2606.22079, Doctolib Lab, 2026-06-20) audited under the BSC framework. T0 Rejected (32/100, cap 69) driven by Stage 3 = 0/80 on all six rubric items: no CI/CD, no CHANGELOG, no data-provenance manifest, no bias/limitations language in the repository, no LICENSE file. A confirmed reproducibility bug (p2_short_floor dual default: 256 vs. 128) and three active # tmp markers on reproducibility-critical pipeline functions are the most actionable immediate findings. Pipeline interface design (Pydantic schemas, JSON extraction, 13/13 E2E P3 pass) and zero AST parse errors are substantive structural strengths.
